name: Afterburner
description: Multiplies maximum speed by 75% while it runs, at a cost of 20 GJ every ten seconds. Cylvar builds it for the express couriers, and the house's logistics office credits it with every delivery that arrived on time.

name: Microwarpdrive
description: Triples maximum speed while it runs at a cost of 40 GJ every ten seconds, and blooms the hull's signature radius six times over for the same span. Cylvar builds it for the express couriers who value the run above the quiet, and the house's propulsion line states the trade plainly: speed bought with visibility.
